a place people come to for business or pleasure
an old, crowed and discarded place
a place for all types of wares and laughter

14932.subject: English Language
14932.question_text: Which of the following groups of items may be found foe sale in the market?
14932.explanation:
From the passage, the items actually mentioned as being sold in the market include:

  • Eggs → “a woman would walk… with half dozen eggs”
  • Sandals → “making sandals from old discarded motor-car tyres”
  • Gold trinkets → “an old goldsmith worked at his dying art… to fashion the lovely trinkets”

These three appear directly in the text as items of trade.

options.text: motor-car tyres, eggs and gold trinkets
country cloth, gold trinkets and sandals
country cloth, copper trinkles and eggs
